race.description: Ronald Mcdonald House Vic/Tas Mile Hcp (Bm84)
race.comment: FIORENOT (2) opts here over Thursday and that looks a great call. He's come back very well, winning fresh then finding the line strongly behind Buccleuch at Caulfield who was heavily supported on Tuesday, albeit not running up to expectations. Crying out for a mile now and finds a very winnable race third up. SUPERFABULISTIC (13) comes down from Sydney with two minor placings this time in. She was luckless in behind them last time and will take catching on the minimum. HE'LL RIP (4) was just behind FIORENOT at Caulfield last time and ran well but his best form has been at 1400m. NATION'S CALL (3) won well enough at Cranbourne and sets up well on the map. GRAND OMAHA (9) should be ready to fire third up and comes out of Group class mare's races.
